events.title: The requirements are verified, but selecting the critical power redundancy topology between §4.2 and App. B requires an engineering decision before design begins.
The layout engine arranged the equipment into rows spanning from R1 through R6, positioning the cabinets within allowable boundaries across the hall floor.

Hydraulic zone Z1 is served by CDU-1, CDU-2, and CDU-3; zone Z2 is served by CDU-4, CDU-5, and CDU-6; and zone Z3 is served by CDU-7, CDU-8, and CDU-9. The coolant distribution units are sized with N+1 redundancy across all hydraulic zones to maintain cooling operations within limits.
The candidate topologies satisfy R01 with normal and failover loading within limits.

Applying rule R15 swaps TX-2500 for in-stock TX-3150 across topologies 2N and DR, bringing lead times within the limit at the expense of higher prospective fault currents. Topology BLOCK meets the tender limit without requiring equipment swaps.
Following the recheck, the fault levels for topologies 2N and DR remain within limits, satisfying rule R01, rule R04 and rule R04b without violations.

The engine successfully established the default paths for the feeder busways from FA-01 through FA-06 and FB-01 through FB-06 alongside the row busways. All busway paths and default pipes conform to the routing clearance limits.
Cooling routed 9 headers and branches on the pipe tiers
